name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: "[BUG]"
labels: bug
assignees: ''

---

## Problem and impact

What are you trying to do, and how does the defect affect it?

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe both outcomes and include the error or unexpected result.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal type definitions, operations and steps, or a focused failing test.
Remove credentials and private data. If reproduction is incomplete, say what is missing.

## Environment

Include package/version, Node version, database engine/version and relevant options.

## Existing behavior and acceptance criteria

Link relevant documentation or related issues. Explain the expected supported usage
and the result that would demonstrate a fix. Any implementation PR must link this issue.
